stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The current-account guide carries template sections that do not fit it (who offers it, money in and out, tax and the like), padding the page.","where":"the sections 'who', 'in and out', 'tax' of the guide","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The page gives no fees, returns or tax amounts, so the reader can't choose between options
The guide's intro line doesn't say what to do
Unclear which line 'every product page has a line...' refers to
'Where to start' is written for employees and has nothing for someone near retirement
The annual ceiling on tax-benefit savings isn't stated
The waiting period set by law isn't stated
The difference between comprehensive and general pension funds is unclear
'Provident payments and personal severance' (תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים) means nothing to the reader
The footer gives a data date, but no numbers appear anywhere
The 'plain language' lines mostly repeat the product name
The daily/renewing buttons under the money market fund are confusing (are they fund types, are they clickable?)
Too many index cards, all looking alike
'Exposed to the dollar or neutralised from it' isn't understood
'A fund that tracks it' on the index cards isn't understood
'A cap per single share' isn't understood
Unclear who the managing company's investment committee is and whether the reader pays them
The abbreviations אג"ח and מק"מ are used before they're explained
Nothing on what changes at 60, or the age for tax-free withdrawal
No information on whether deposits or bonds are insured or guaranteed
No simple starting point based on amount and time horizon
Would drop the 'for children' section
Would drop most of the index cards
Would drop the self-directed section

problems.why: The report never discusses a current-account guide or template sections (who offers it, money in and out, tax) that pad a page; it covers a general guide overview instead.
